qa_pairs.question: What kind of power adapter should I use to charge the NovaBook 14, and which ports can it charge through?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The NovaBook 14 charges through either of its USB-C ports with a 65 W USB-C Power Delivery adapter. A lower-wattage adapter may charge slowly and may not maintain charge during heavy use.

contexts.text: It charges through either USB-C port with a 65 W USB-C Power Delivery adapter. A lower-wattage adapter may charge slowly but may not maintain charge during heavy use.

qa_pairs.question: Will OrbitTech staff ever ask me for my password or a one-time authentication code?

qa_pairs.question: Can I buy a device with OrbitPay instalments, and how is the payment split? Can I use a gift card for the first payment?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: OrbitPay instalments are available for eligible device purchases of at least USD 300 after discounts. The plan requires 25% at checkout followed by three equal monthly payments. Gift cards cannot fund the initial 25%.

qa_pairs.question: My package has not moved in tracking for days. When is it considered delayed, what will support do, and what happens if that investigation fails?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A package is considered delayed when it has no tracking update for three business days beyond the latest estimated delivery date. Support may then open a carrier trace; no refund or replacement is issued while the trace is within its five-business-day investigation period. If the carrier trace fails, the case may move to a specialist.

contexts.text: A package is considered delayed when it has no tracking update for three business days beyond the latest estimated delivery date. At that point, support may open a carrier trace. A refund or replacement is not issued while an active trace is within its five-business-day investigation period.
A case may move to a specialist when it involves a failed carrier trace

qa_pairs.question: I ordered in September 2026 and already opened my device. Can I still return it, what fee applies, and how soon will I get my refund?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Yes, for orders placed on or after September 1, 2026 an opened standard device can be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee, unless it is a defective device verified during the return window, which is not charged the fee. After inspection, the refund goes to the original payment methods within five to seven business days.

contexts.text: An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee. A defective device verified during the return window is not charged a restocking fee.
After inspection, refunds are issued to the original payment methods within five to seven business days.

qa_pairs.question: After I send my device in for a covered repair, how long will diagnosis and repair usually take, and what if a part is out of stock for a long time?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Initial diagnosis normally takes up to three business days after the service centre receives the product, and a covered repair normally takes up to ten additional business days when parts are available. These periods exclude shipping time and time waiting for customer approval. If a required part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, support must offer an escalation review for an alternative remedy.

contexts.text: Initial diagnosis normally takes up to three business days after the service centre receives the product. A covered repair normally takes up to ten additional business days when parts are available. These periods exclude shipping time and time waiting for customer approval.
If a required part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, support must offer an escalation review for an alternative remedy.

qa_pairs.question: As an OrbitPlus member, can I get a loaner device while my laptop is being repaired, and what conditions apply?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Active OrbitPlus members may request a loaner for a covered laptop or phone repair. It is subject to availability, identity verification, and a refundable USD 200 deposit.

contexts.text: Active OrbitPlus members may request a loaner for a covered laptop or phone repair, subject to availability, identity verification, and a refundable USD 200 deposit.
Members may receive a loaner during some covered repairs under `07_repair_and_technical_support.md`, subject to availability and a refundable deposit.

qa_pairs.question: I think someone got into my OrbitTech account and placed an order I did not make. What should I do?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security. If the unauthorized order is still Confirmed, also try to cancel it from the account page. If it is already packing or dispatched, Account Security coordinates with the Payments and Delivery teams, but cancellation or interception is not guaranteed.

contexts.text: A customer who suspects account compromise should reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security.
If it is already packing or dispatched, Account Security coordinates with the Payments and Delivery teams; cancellation or interception is not guaranteed.
An order can be cancelled from the account page while its status is `Confirmed`.

qa_pairs.question: If my warranty claim is approved, what remedy will I get, and how long is a replacement part or replacement device covered?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Warranty service may result in repair, replacement with an equivalent new or refurbished unit, or a refund when repair or replacement are not reasonable; OrbitTech chooses the remedy after diagnosis. Replacement parts are covered for the longer of 90 calendar days or the remainder of the original warranty, and a replacement device does not restart a new 24-month warranty.

contexts.text: Warranty service may result in repair, replacement with an equivalent new or refurbished unit, or refund when the first two remedies are not reasonable. OrbitTech chooses the remedy after diagnosis.
Replacement parts are covered for the longer of 90 calendar days or the remainder of the original warranty. A replacement device does not restart a new 24-month warranty.

qa_pairs.question: I am an OrbitPlus member. I ordered an unopened NovaBook 14 on August 28, 2026 and it was delivered on September 3, 2026. How many days do I have to return it, and does my membership give me 45 days?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Return Policy version 1.0 applies because the order was placed before September 1, 2026; the order-placement date decides the version, while the days are counted from confirmed delivery. Version 1.0 allows 21 calendar days for an unopened device, so the window runs 21 days from the September 3 delivery. The 45-day OrbitPlus benefit does not apply, because orders placed before September 1 keep the 21-day window regardless of membership.

contexts.text: For return-policy eligibility, the triggering event is the order-placement date, while the number of return days is counted from confirmed delivery.
Return Policy version 1.0 applies to orders placed before September 1, 2026. It allowed 21 calendar days for unopened devices
Orders placed before September 1 keep the 21-day version 1.0 window regardless of membership.

qa_pairs.question: I ordered an unopened PulsePhone X on September 10, 2026 without a membership and joined OrbitPlus on September 12. Do I now get the 45-day return window?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. The order falls under Return Policy version 2.0, and the 45-day OrbitPlus extension applies only when OrbitPlus was active on the order date. Activating OrbitPlus after the order does not change it retroactively, so the standard 30-calendar-day window after confirmed delivery for an unopened device applies.

contexts.text: For version 2.0 orders, the extension applies only when OrbitPlus was active on the order date.
The membership benefit must be active when the order is placed. Activating OrbitPlus after an order does not retroactively change the price or shipping fee.
For orders placed on or after September 1, 2026, an unopened standard device may be returned within 30 calendar days after confirmed delivery.

qa_pairs.question: I bought a promotional bundle with a NovaBook 14 and a free gift, opened the laptop, and changed my mind after 10 days. If I return only the laptop and keep the free gift, what will be deducted from my refund?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The opened laptop is still within the 14-calendar-day opened-device window, but it is subject to a 10% restocking fee because this is a preference return, not a verified defect. Because the bundle is not returned as a bundle, the stated promotional value of the kept free gift is deducted from the refund. The original standard-shipping fee is also not refunded for a preference return.

contexts.text: A promotional bundle must be returned as a bundle. If a customer keeps a free gift or one bundled item, its stated promotional value is deducted from the refund.
An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee.
Original standard-shipping fees are not refunded for preference returns.

qa_pairs.question: My repair authorization for an excluded issue was created before a new repair policy version was published. If I decline the repair quote, what will I be charged and which policy version decides the fee?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: For an excluded issue OrbitTech sends a written quote valid for seven calendar days. If you decline, a USD 35 diagnostic fee applies unless remote support confirmed before shipment that no diagnostic fee would be charged. The fee follows the policy version accepted when the repair authorization was created, not the later version.

contexts.text: For an out-of-warranty or excluded issue, OrbitTech sends a written quote. The quote remains valid for seven calendar days.
If the customer declines, a diagnostic fee of USD 35 applies unless remote support confirmed before shipment that no diagnostic fee would be charged.
For repair fees, the applicable policy is the version accepted when the repair authorization is created.

qa_pairs.question: My PulsePhone X got wet 18 months after delivery. I joined OrbitPlus the next day. Is the repair free under warranty now?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. Although the PulsePhone X is still within its 24-month warranty period, liquid exposure is excluded from the warranty, and purchasing OrbitPlus after the incident does not convert the damage into a warranty claim. The damage may still be repairable for a fee: OrbitTech sends a written quote for an excluded issue. Until then, the wet phone should be powered down when safe and disconnected from charging.

contexts.text: OrbitTech provides a 24-month limited hardware warranty for the NovaBook 14, PulsePhone X, and HomeHub Mini.
The warranty excludes loss, theft, cosmetic wear, depleted consumables, accidental impact, liquid exposure
Accidental damage may still be repairable for a fee, but it is not converted into a warranty claim by purchasing OrbitPlus after the incident.
For an out-of-warranty or excluded issue, OrbitTech sends a written quote.
A device that is overheating, smoking, swollen, or wet should be powered down when safe and disconnected from charging.

qa_pairs.expected_answer: The premise is incorrect: OrbitPlus does not discount devices, so there is no 20% member discount to apply to a PulsePhone X. The member discount is 5% on regularly priced OrbitTech accessories, and the assistant cannot invent a discount or promise an exception.

contexts.text: It must not invent a product specification, delivery status, discount, or legal right.
